prompt:
Create a bold editorial breaking-news social graphic.

SUBJECT
Use the attached subject photograph as the primary subject, placed on the left half of the composition. Keep the subject photographic and naturally coloured. Do not distort, stylise or recolour the subject.

ACCENT COLOUR
Apply the selected accent colour (signal red (#DC2626)) to the bold geometric graphic elements in the background: a large vertical bar on the right, one or two horizontal rule lines, and a strong rectangular block behind the subject's head.

STYLE
Use a crisp Swiss-modernist graphic style with clean rules, strong geometric shapes, and disciplined negative space.

SPACE
Leave the right third of the composition free of the subject. This area will carry text overlaid in post-production.

FORMAT
Tall vertical 4:5 composition.

AVOID
Do not add any text, numbers, captions, logos or watermarks.

ADDITIONAL ELEMENTS
Add the following to the composition. Keep the layout and hierarchy described above.
Add four to six bold geometric shapes to the composition, using only these shapes: rectangles and circles. Render them as solid, flat-filled shapes in signal red (#DC2626). Place them behind the subject, so the subject overlaps them. Give the shapes clean, sharp edges and deliberate, balanced positions, so they feel art-directed rather than scattered.

THEME
The following treatment applies to the whole finished image. Where it conflicts with any earlier instruction, follow this section.
Render the entire image in true black and white, with neutral greys and no colour cast. Use a high-contrast look with deep blacks and bright whites. Apply this to everything in the frame, including the subject, the background and all graphic elements. This overrides any earlier colour instruction.

Organise the whole composition as a contemporary editorial magazine collage with strong Swiss-inspired geometric organisation: asymmetric editorial layout, strong foreground/background hierarchy, disciplined negative space and minimal visual clutter.

ADDITIONAL RULES
- Do not use any colour anywhere in the image.
- Do not add shapes other than the ones listed.
